name: Shorterm
author: dimitrisevis

sections.description:
Shorterm is a powerful and easy-to-use URL shortener for WordPress. Create clean, simple, and memorable short links directly from your dashboard. This version allows you to quickly generate random short URLs for any link.

Upgrade to Shorterm Pro to unlock amazing features:
* Custom Slugs: Create branded short links like yourdomain.com/promo.
* Click Analytics: Track every click with detailed reports on referrers, browsers, and location.
* Link Expiration: Set links to expire after a certain date or number of clicks.
* Password Protection: Secure your links with a password.
* And much more!

Find out more at shorterm.eu.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shorterm folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP, or upload the zip file through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Shorterm” menu in your WordPress admin sidebar to start creating links!
sections.faq:
How do I create a short link?

Navigate to the Shorterm dashboard, paste your long URL into the “Original URL” field, and click “Generate Link”. Your new short link will appear in the table below.

Can I customize the short link slug?

Custom slugs (e.g., yourdomain.com/my-custom-link) are a premium feature available in Shorterm Pro.

Where can I find documentation?

Basic usage is covered here. For more advanced topics and information on the Pro version, please visit our official website.
